items.responds_to: Nest 12's @nestjs/common exports map hides the interfaces directory under nodenext, causing throttler's ModuleMetadata type to degrade and making imports appear required.

items.change: Changed the library-storage canary to expect that one client's unblock no longer strands another client's pending decrements.

items.responds_to: @nestjs/platform-express 12 pins multer 2.4.0, which already includes the advisory fix the override was providing.

items.change: Updated the Nest throttler memory index entry from the upgrade being blocked to Nest 12 having landed, recording the exports-map and @nestjs/config transition traps.
items.responds_to: Nest 12 support became available in @nestjs/throttler and exposed the common exports-map typing issue.

items.change: Updated the rate-limit documentation to record that the throttler storage canary now pins the upstream cross-client cancellation fix while the custom storage remains necessary for Date.now() clock-step behavior.
items.responds_to: @nestjs/throttler 6.6.0 fixed cross-client cancellation but did not change the Date.now()-based expiration behavior.

items.change: Replaced the note that Nest 12 was blocked with documentation of the released throttler peer support, the exports-map typing issue requiring imports: [], the upstream storage fix, and removal of the multer override.
items.responds_to: Nest 12 and throttler 6.6+ changed peer support, package exports resolution, throttler storage behavior, and the platform-express multer dependency.
